title: Use explicit CI budgets after measuring the mobile profile
context: PR 16 CI missed the original 2000ms LCP and 150ms TBT targets. Startup repairs passed size and accessibility checks but did not establish those timing targets.
options: Continue optimizing against the original limits.
Approve 3200ms LCP and 250ms TBT for this CI profile.
choice: The owner approved 3200ms LCP and 250ms TBT on October 14, 2026, with every required check still enforced.
tradeoff: CI accepts slower simulated paint and more blocking. This does not establish good field performance; tighter field targets remain.
